description: World Dishes: national and regional dishes by country. Look up the dishes Wikidata links to a country (ISO3), or search a dish by name in English or Japanese. Returns Wikidata QID, English and Japanese names and every country the dish is linked to. Values as recorded in Wikidata; nothing estimated. Coverage reflects Wikidata, so some countries have few or no dishes. Routes: /dish (q*, limit); /dishes (iso3*, limit). Paid $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /dish, /dishes. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: world-dishes
